facts.fact: Statistics Sierra Leone issued the Extended Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (E-NSDS-II), extending NSDS II (2016-2020) so that NSDS III can be designed later to match the next national development plan; the document is dated November 2023.
A mid-term review of the second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II) was carried out in 2018 and identified weaknesses in the Statistics Act.
